texts.zh:
[goo_slayer.GetName]最近摧毁了一个位于L-星团深处的[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]星系的大型空间设施。与此同时，随着该设施的反应核心爆炸，德萨努协和国的一切都化作了尘埃。

他们的文明已经灭亡了。
texts.en:
The [goo_slayer.GetName] recently destroyed a large space installation of some kind in the [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system, deep inside the L-Cluster. At the same instant as the installation's reactor core detonated, what remained of the Dessanu Consonance crumbled into inert nanite dust.

Their civilization is no more.
